title: Device preferences
description: Exactly one versioned JSON file stores these preferences in Platform application-support data. The file is not part of a Workspace, Git history, or `schema.sql`. The persistence layer replaces it atomically by writing a temporary file and renaming it. Unknown `schema_version` values or corrupt bytes produce in-memory defaults, isolate the corrupt file, and do not crash the application. The current schema version is 1. `platform_chrome` must not appear because SHELL-G001 removes that preference.

schema_version.description: Version of this persisted preference payload. Version 1 is the current version.

update_notifications.description: When true, check for and notify about compatible higher 0.x releases as specified by UPDATE-M010. When false, do not check.
